test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01fa12c055ede50dae109cbe028f1593efed5c5754c16ecb0e10a85e71e133e8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first two elements from the left interchange positions.

The last two elements from the left interchange positions.

The center element is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb6a85f278b131b5698da48b448f4005bdb691c7d08f46bfb7264301b621c747.png] 

2) Second box series → 

All the elements shift anticlockwise.

The fourth element from the left is replaced by new element.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/455d561ef10413df83151d15c78fd918815a7c094a91135fed741cfc72518ddb.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1476dab717d6e7accf91fe0a4d4fecbcab51e22174ce4ac75472d2403c5d0fe4.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
